parameters.description: Required. The name of the release resource, which is the parent of the feedback report resources. Format: `projects/{project_number}/apps/{app}/releases/{release}`

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Output only. The maximum number of feedback reports to return. The service may return fewer than this value. The valid range is [1-100]; If unspecified (0), at most 25 feedback reports are returned...

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Output only. A page token, received from a previous `ListFeedbackReports` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListFeedbackReports`...

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required. The name of the feedback report to retrieve. Format: projects/{project_number}/apps/{app}/releases/{release}/feedbackReports/{feedback_report}

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required. The name of the feedback report to delete. Format: projects/{project_number}/apps/{app}/releases/{release}/feedbackReports/{feedback_report}

upload.description: Uploads a binary. Uploading a binary can result in a new release being created, an update to an existing release, or a no-op if a release with the same binary already exists.

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Required. The name of the app resource. Format: `projects/{project_number}/apps/{app}`
